# Support

Skyformac is a small, maintainer-run project — here's where to go depending
on what you need:

- **Bug reports** — [open an issue](https://github.com/giulioroggero/skyformac/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
  Include your macOS version, camera/hardware model, and steps to reproduce.
- **Feature requests / ideas** — [open an issue](https://github.com/giulioroggero/skyformac/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Questions about using the app** — check the [README](../README.md) and
  [`docs/`](../docs/) first (architecture, design notes, feature list,
  distribution/install instructions); if that doesn't answer it, open a
  [Discussion](https://github.com/giulioroggero/skyformac/discussions) or an
  issue.
- **Security vulnerabilities** — do **not** open a public issue; see
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for how to report privately.
- **Hardware to lend/send for testing** — see
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md); reach out via
  [Issues](https://github.com/giulioroggero/skyformac/issues).

There is no dedicated support channel (no Slack/Discord) — issues and
discussions on GitHub are the primary way to reach the maintainer.
